## Description

/patients/:id/timeline: one chronological list across encounters, labs, medicines, documents with filters (All, Encounters, Labs, Medicines, Documents, source) and provenance tags (Medvya · signed, Clinician verified, Lab feed, Synced from HIS, Uploaded by patient, Imported). Trend chart toggle (HbA1c / BP / weight) with values and dates. "Load earlier…" pagination.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Each entry shows date, title, subtitle, author/source and provenance tag.
- [ ] **AC2.** Filters combine and persist per user session; empty filter result shows a clear empty state.
- [ ] **AC3.** Trend charts show values with units and dates, accessible as a data table for screen readers.
- [ ] **AC4.** Pagination loads older entries without losing scroll position.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
